The full test suite is green — there are only 3 test files (`AcceptanceTest` plus two support classes `AcceptanceBase` and `AuditLogCapture`), so `AcceptanceTest` is the entire runnable suite, and it passes.

## Summary

I implemented the GOLD membership tier rule. The membership tier is a derived value computed at DTO-mapping time in `OwnerMapper`, so that's where the rule lives.

**Change** — `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`:
- Converted the mapper from an `interface` to an `abstract class` (MapStruct supports both; the generated `OwnerMapperImpl` extends it) so it can hold an injected dependency.
- Injected `ClinicService` via an `@Autowired` field (Spring autowires the inherited field on the generated `@Component` subclass — the project sets `mapstruct.defaultComponentModel=spring`). No circular dependency, since `ClinicServiceImpl` depends only on repositories.
